entities.name: UL transfer of IRAT information
entities.description: Procedure to transfer from the UE to NR MCG dedicated information terminated at the NR MCG but specified by another RAT, such as E-UTRA MeasurementReport or E-UTRA SidelinkUEInformation.

entities.name: ULInformationTransferIRAT
entities.description: Message sent from UE to NR to transfer IRAT dedicated information.

entities.name: UL information transfer MR-DC
entities.description: Procedure to transfer MR-DC dedicated information from the UE to the network, including messages like NR/E-UTRA RRC MeasurementReport, FailureInformation, UEAssistanceInformation, RRCReconfigurationComplete, or MCGFailureInformation.

entities.name: ULInformationTransferMRDC
entities.description: Message sent from UE to Network to transfer MR-DC dedicated information.

entities.name: IRAT dedicated information
entities.description: Dedicated information specified by another RAT, terminated at NR MCG, such as E-UTRA MeasurementReport or E-UTRA SidelinkUEInformation.

entities.name: MR-DC dedicated information
entities.description: MR-DC dedicated information transferred from UE to network, including NR/E-UTRA RRC MeasurementReport, FailureInformation, UEAssistanceInformation, RRCReconfigurationComplete, or MCGFailureInformation.

relations.description: The UL transfer of IRAT information procedure involves sending the ULInformationTransferIRAT message.
The ULInformationTransferIRAT message contains IRAT dedicated information.
The UL information transfer MR-DC procedure involves sending the ULInformationTransferMRDC message.
The ULInformationTransferMRDC message contains MR-DC dedicated information.
